notes: Awaroa Inlet: you can cross only from 1 hour 30 minutes before low tide to 2 hours after low tide. There is no high-tide track. Plan your days with the tide table.
Torrent Bay and Bark Bay have a low-tide crossing and a longer all-tide track.
Water taxis stop at many of the beaches. You can walk a part of the track and go back by boat.
Boil or treat the water at the campsites.

pois.name: Cleopatra's Pool
pois.text: Rock pool with a natural water slide. The side track up the Torrent River takes about 20 minutes each way.

pois.name: Falls River
pois.text: A swing bridge of 47 m crosses the Falls River here. It is the longest bridge on the track.

pois.name: Separation Point
pois.text: The point between Tasman Bay and Golden Bay. Fur seals live on the rocks. A side track goes down to the light.

pois.name: Tonga Quarry
pois.text: Granite from this quarry went to buildings in Nelson and Wellington about 1900. Cut blocks are still on the beach.

pois.name: Awaroa Inlet
pois.text: Wide tidal inlet. Cross it only near low tide. The crossing takes about 25 minutes.
